discussion:
Imported from role task file `tasks/section_2/section_2.3.7.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-2022-CIS` and Audit control `section_2/section_2.3.7/cis_2.3.7.9.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-2022-CIS-Audit`. The CIS Benchmark text is not part of this source.

No runnable check (number variable sc_remove_option does not fit REG_SZ); the original Ansible tasks are the fix.

steps.name: Original Ansible tasks
steps.shell:
- name: "2.3.7.9 | PATCH | Ensure Interactive logon Smart card removal behavior is set to Lock Workstation or higher"
  when: win22cis_rule_2_3_7_9
  tags:
    - level1-domaincontroller
    - level1-memberserver
    - rule_2.3.7.9
    - patch
    - logon
    - NIST800-171_3.1.1
    - NIST800-171_3.1.10
    - NIST800-171_3.1.11
    - NIST800-53R5_AC-2_5
    - NIST800-53R5_AC-11
    - NIST800-53R5_AC-11_1
    - NIST800-53R5_AC-12
  block:
    - name: "2.3.7.9 | PATCH | Ensure Interactive logon Smart card removal behavior is set to Lock Workstation or higher | Apply Settings To Registry"
      when:
        - win22cis_sc_remove_option >= 1
        - win22cis_sc_remove_option <= 3
      ansible.windows.win_regedit:
        path: HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows Nt\CurrentVersion\Winlogon
        name: ScRemoveOption
        data: "{{ win22cis_sc_remove_option }}"
        type: string

    - name: "2.3.7.9 | AUDIT | Ensure Interactive logon Smart card removal behavior is set to Lock Workstation or higher | Warning Check For Variable Standards"
      when: win22cis_sc_remove_option == 0 or
          win22cis_sc_remove_option > 3
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg:
          - "Warning!! You have an invalid setting for win22cis_sc_remove_option. Please read"
          - "the notes for the variable and make the necessary change to the variable to be in compliance."

    - name: "2.3.7.9 | AUDIT | Ensure Interactive logon Smart card removal behavior is set to Lock Workstation or higher | Warn Count"
      when: win22cis_sc_remove_option == 0 or
          win22cis_sc_remove_option > 3
      vars:
        warn_control_id: '2.3.7.9'
      ansible.builtin.import_tasks:
        file: warning_facts.yml
